title: verl
description: Scalable RL training library for LLMs, with PPO, GRPO and many recent variants.

title: TRL
description: Hugging Face library for SFT, reward modeling, DPO, GRPO and other post-training methods.

title: OpenRLHF
description: Ray and vLLM based framework for RLHF and RL training at scale.

title: LLaMA-Factory
description: Unified fine-tuning for hundreds of LLMs and VLMs, from SFT to preference optimization.

title: EasyR1
description: Efficient RL training for vision-language models, built on verl.

title: LMFlow
description: Toolkit for fine-tuning and aligning large models. I implemented CW-PO in it.

title: Unsloth
description: Fast, memory-efficient LoRA fine-tuning and RL on a single GPU.

title: vLLM
description: High-throughput LLM inference and serving engine with PagedAttention.

title: SGLang
description: Fast serving framework for LLMs and VLMs, widely used for RL rollouts.

title: TTRL
description: Test-time reinforcement learning on unlabeled data, using majority vote as the reward.

title: OPSD
description: On-policy self-distillation for LLMs.

title: Search-R1
description: Training LLMs to reason and call search engines with reinforcement learning.

title: FlashRAG
description: Python toolkit for reproducing and building retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.

title: Model Context Protocol
description: Docs for MCP, the open protocol for connecting LLM agents to tools and data.

title: mergekit
description: Tools for merging pretrained and fine-tuned language models.

title: On-Policy Distillation
description: Thinking Machines on training a student on its own samples with dense teacher feedback.

title: lm-evaluation-harness
description: EleutherAI's standard framework for few-shot evaluation of language models.

title: lmms-eval
description: Evaluation suite for large multimodal models across image, video and audio tasks.

title: VLMEvalKit
description: Open-source toolkit for evaluating vision-language models on many benchmarks.

title: TransformerLens
description: Library for mechanistic interpretability of GPT-style language models.

title: nnsight
description: Interpret and intervene on the internals of PyTorch models, including large remote ones.

title: Lil'Log
description: Lilian Weng's blog with long, careful surveys of RL, LLM agents, alignment and more.

title: RLHF Book
description: Nathan Lambert's book on reinforcement learning from human feedback and post-training.

title: Spinning Up in Deep RL
description: OpenAI's educational introduction to deep reinforcement learning.

title: The Annotated Transformer
description: A line-by-line implementation of the Transformer paper.

title: BanglaBERT
description: Pretrained Bangla language model and benchmark from BUET CSE NLP.
